snippet.title: Fart Together - Demo Trailer (Steam) | GamesMrkt
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist Fart Together on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5117550/Fart_Together/

🦛💨 Fart Together is a chaotic physics-based co-op game where teamwork, timing, and fart power are the only things keeping your raft on course.

Grab your friends, jump on the same raft, and try to survive challenging obstacle courses without blaming each other when everything goes wrong.

🎮 2–4 players on the same raft  
🌊 Physics-based co-op chaos  
💨 Powered by farts  
🏁 Challenging obstacle courses  
😂 Friendship may not survive

The Fart Together demo is coming very soon on Steam, just in time for Steam Next Fest!

Wishlisting the game is one of the best ways to support us and helps Fart Together reach more players on Steam.

See you on the raft. 🦛💨
